answer.thought: The silence in the bungalow is heavy, a physical weight that presses against the temples. With no file and no food, I turn to the only substance I can control: the text. I open the Philosophy of Right to §33, seeking the grounding of the ethical in the family and state, though the empty kitchen makes the concept of 'ethical substance' feel like a cruel irony.
